boundary_decision.rationale: The subject-model entry kind aggregate is sound because one handling case coordinates intake, work, assessments, decisions, communications and handoffs without absorbing external masters. The frozen registry value standalone-mm classifies the record plane and does not conflict with the subject-model kind.

decisions.concept: Handling case versus Insurance Claim master
decisions.rationale: The Insurance Claim master owns claim identity and substantive policy-loss-demand assertions. WM-ACT-045 owns one processing case, its assignments, evidence use, assessments, decisions, communications and handoffs. Five boundary notes and non-cascade policies preserve that division.

decisions.concept: Notification, coverage, decision, settlement and payment separation
decisions.rationale: Separate findings and functions distinguish receipt, completeness, policy binding, coverage and liability assessment, reasoned result, offer, acceptance, external payment instruction and observed execution. The model explicitly rejects shortcuts among these states.

A source-qualified indicator may start a restricted referral but cannot become a fraud finding or silently prejudice ordinary handling. Adverse action requires attributable authority and a review path; an external Fraud Case owns the investigation outcome.

The registry ledger proposes WM-ECO-036 COMPOSE WM-ACT-045 for claim-versus-process separation. It remains candidate metadata, not an approved edge. The standalone handling specification is coherent through a required external claim reference, so this limits relationship-completeness claims but does not block reviewable-draft publication.

Released assessments, evidence-use records, decisions, offers and settlements are immutable. Reopening or correction creates a separately identified successor with reason, authority, event and knowledge times, preventing audit history from being overwritten.

Default-deny access covers personal, health, financial, location, fraud, legal, reserve and settlement-strategy data. Purpose-bound exceptions require authority, scope and logging. Concrete role bindings, redaction and jurisdictional rights must be supplied by the adopting Dimension profile.

IAIS supplies the neutral conduct baseline. NAIC, FCA, EIOPA, EU and UK sources are explicit regional profiles. FHIR R5 financial resources are Trial Use and ACORD evidence is public overview only; neither supports a universal or full conformance claim.

One Claude Sonnet and one Grok 4.6 attempt for WM-ACT-045 each timed out after 120 seconds. Owner-approved policy permits source-grounded Codex fallback after this separate no-tools audit. Confidence remains medium and assurance remains reviewable-draft with a visible absence-of-external-review hold.
